_about: Food safety records linked to a spot on our map, checked by hand: the name AND the location must match. TG SAFE lists often name a brand without the branch, and Hyderabad brands run many branches, so a name match alone is not a link. Regenerate candidates with: node scripts/suggest-inspection-links.mjs

links.name: Hameedi Confectionaries
links.why: Official TG SAFE record names Hameedi Confectionaries in MJ Market; our spot is Hameedi Confectioners at 5-5-513, Mozamjahi Market.

links.name: Taj Falaknuma Palace
links.why: Official TG SAFE record names Taj Falaknuma Palace; our spot is Adaa - Taj Falaknuma Palace at Engine Bowli, Falaknuma.

links.name: Pista House
links.why: Official TG SAFE record names Pista House in Shahalibanda; our spot is Pista House Shahalibanda on Charminar Road.

links.name: Sohail Restaurant
links.why: Official TG SAFE record names Sohail Restaurant in Malakpet; our spot is HOTEL SOHAIL on Government Printing Press Road at Chanchalguda / Malakpet.

links.name: Dine Hill Restaurant
links.why: Official TG SAFE record names Dine Hill Restaurant in Masab Tank; our spot is Dine Hill on Mehdipatnam - Banjara Hills Road in Masab Tank.

links.name: Hotel Nayaab
links.why: Official TG SAFE record names Hotel Nayaab in Nayapul; our spot is the landmark Hotel Nayaab at 22-8-111, Nayapul Road.

links.name: Majestic Sweets
links.why: The official record names Majestic Sweets in Tolichowki; our spot is Majestic Sweets Namkeen on 7 Tombs Road in Toli Chowki.

links.name: White Elephant Food Works (63 Degrees Modern Regional Buffet)
links.why: Record names 63 Degrees as the outlet; our spot is on Mindspace Rd, Gachibowli, the drive's area.

links.name: Hotel Avasa
links.why: Single Avasa hotel; our spot is on Hitech City Main Road, the drive's area.

links.name: Hotel Kinara Grand Restaurant and Bar
links.why: Record says Vanasthalipuram (LB Nagar zone drive); this branch is on NH 65 by Vishnu Theatre at 17.339, 78.567. The other Kinara Grand is in Hafeezpet and is NOT linked.

links.name: Scuzi Hospitality Private Limited
links.why: The inspected Madhapur establishment matches the existing Scuzi India spot in Kakatiya Hills, Madhapur.
